question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Pacify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pacify"** means to bring peace to a situation or person, often by calming them down or resolving their concerns. (शांत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She tried to pacify the crying baby by rocking him gently.
 
 
 
• **"Enrage"** refers to making someone very angry or infuriated. (क्रोधित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **His rude comments were enough to enrage everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Pacify' **is **'Enrage'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Restore **(पुनर्स्थापित करना): To bring back to a previous state or condition.

 
 
• **Example:** The government plans to restore the old building to its former glory.
 
 
 
• **Negate **(नकारना): To deny the existence or truth of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The evidence negates his claim of innocence.
 
 
 
• **Amuse** (मनोरंजन करना): To entertain or make someone laugh.
 
 
• **Example:** The clown at the party managed to amuse all the children.
